queries: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), overall AS (SELECT AVG(match_count::numeric) AS avg_match_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS average_of_average_ratios, SUM(g.match_count) AS total_match_count, AVG(g.match_count - overall.avg_match_count) AS average_excess_match_count FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall WHERE g.match_count > overall.avg_match_count;

WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS match_count, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_match_count FROM fee_groups) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(g.match_count) AS total_match_count, AVG(g.match_count - a.avg_match_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM fee_groups AS g CROSS JOIN group_average AS a WHERE g.match_count > a.avg_match_count;

WITH per_group AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS match_count, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), cross_group AS (SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_match_count FROM per_group) SELECT AVG(p.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, SUM(p.match_count) AS total_match_count, AVG(p.match_count - c.avg_match_count) AS average_excess_match_count FROM per_group AS p CROSS JOIN cross_group AS c WHERE p.match_count > c.avg_match_count
